scope: 3:4 proof slide only before full batch

slides.repair: include two human hands and paired personal objects
make the leaving ritual physically specific
use body-memory and shared charger/blanket, not generic cozy pose

slides.risk: form labels, hospital melodrama, or caretaker pose
slides.repair: calm paperwork desk, blank lines only, mutual closeness
two keys/two shoes/home light must prove the line

hard_requirements_for_generation: Exact on-image text must be present.
No random text except approved slide copy and brandmark.
